targets.name: Etched swallow
targets.concealment: Thin frosted wings and forked tail blend into the tall panel’s pale floral etching and reflected window shapes.

targets.name: Etched heron on a window
targets.concealment: The pale long-legged bird is incorporated in dense frosted botanical lines and mottled light at the far end of the room.

targets.name: Etched stag head
targets.concealment: The head and thin antlers are integrated into dense etched foliage and glass reflections; a jug overlaps the lower bust.

targets.name: Etched running hare
targets.concealment: The flat pale animal is part of a small rear drawer relief, camouflaged by equally light floral linework and perspective.

targets.name: Frosted crouching cat
targets.concealment: The small pale fox is partly nested between densely etched glass objects and backed by matching amber and frosted textures.

targets.name: Frosted shelf bird
targets.concealment: The small pale bird’s feathers echo the surrounding etched leaves and angled bottle edges high on a narrow shelf.

targets.name: Sleeping porcelain mouse
targets.concealment: The small curled cream animal blends with frosted glass reflections and the speckled shelf, its low horizontal body half absorbed in the clutter.

targets.name: Little porcelain hedgehog
targets.concealment: The pale textured spines repeat etched white lines and rough stone texture in a shadowed nook below the bench.

targets.name: Pale nautilus ornament
targets.concealment: The ridged spiral is tucked beneath a bench among the same cream curves and frosted patterns as the surrounding glassware.

targets.name: Tortoise below the bench
targets.concealment: The low olive-brown shell follows the timber grain and patterned shadows, with its legs partly lost against the shelving.

targets.name: Pierced ivory ball
targets.concealment: The perforated ball is partly crossed by a small clamp and shares its tone with dense circular floral etching nearby.

targets.name: Blue etched mug
targets.concealment: The broad cobalt mug stands out on the left foreground bench.

targets.name: Red floral cushion
targets.concealment: The large red fabric cushion is exposed on the right-hand bench.

targets.name: Green enamel jug
targets.concealment: The green jug is plainly exposed on the right shelf.

targets.name: Cream botanical notebook
targets.concealment: The pale notebook is clearly displayed in the lower left foreground.

review.notes: All15 targets reviewed in source-context overlays. Enlarged source-coordinate grids corrected swallow wings, shelf bird beak, hare ears, complete tortoise shell and the actual stag-head relief; pierced-ball mask excludes its foreground clamp. Eleven authored challenging placements and four clear anchors; phone playtesting pending. Visible handle/open key-bow openings checked in enlarged affine ROIs and excluded from reveal/preview masks. Glass lenses remain part of their magnifier targets.
